name: Narusawa Ryouka
source:
An energetic spirit guide with enormous breasts who is Yuuta's best friend. Calls herself "Ryo-tas", and [url=/c55837]Yuuta[/url] "Gamotan". She wields an electric stun-gun shaped like an old-fashioned raygun which is dubbed the "Poya-gun" according to Yuuta.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occultic;Nine]Wikipedia[/url]]
